item.title: Anonymous AI Model 'Ox Alpha' Crushes Coding Benchmarks, Sparking a Cross-Country Guessing Game

item.title: iKang and Huawei Cloud Launch AI Agent for Enterprise Health Management
item.description: On August 21, iKang Group and Huawei Cloud jointly launched an AI health management agent that extends AI to corporate employee health, covering data, personalized plans, ongoing intervention, monitoring and risk alerts.

item.title: Honor's Humanoid Robot 'Lightning' Runs 400m in 40.6 Seconds, Beating the Human World Record
item.description: At the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, Honor's self-developed robot Lightning ran 400m in 40.6 seconds, beating the 43.03s human men's world record set by Wayde van Niekerk at the 2016 Rio Olympics.
